rootCause: Normal verified pull updates preference state but leaves an equal-document stale CAS conflict in the outbox. That row blocks later jobs and remains counted as pending. The resource page has no per-conflict resolver; whole-account replace has different semantics.
resolution: Only a normal pull record from this instance's independently verified read can resolve. Owner/resource/auth UID, authority action, current Accounts epoch and actor session/device/client must match. Current local revision and canonical document must match the original conflict; only RESOURCE_PREFERENCE_CONFLICT with an older bound base revision becomes superseded.
boundaries: Different document or newer local version retains conflict.
Wrong owner/resource/auth UID or unmatched authority is rejected.
Epoch/session/device/SDK client changes during read or epoch change before apply are rejected.
Older authority cannot downgrade newer state.
Without the main-only epoch capability, convergence stays conservative.
Transaction failure rolls back preference/state/outbox changes.
A later genuine saved edit can proceed using the accepted cloud revision; the rejected action stays superseded and unverified.
